policy.rule: The done boolean is the only completion field. A row is Done only when its entire acceptance contract has passing end-to-end evidence. Existing code, unsupported scope, missing proof and failed budgets all remain Not done.
policy.scope: Union of professional drafting, mechanical/product design and specialist CAD workflows. Product/edition entitlements are not asserted; specialist rows remain visible and count as Not done until delivered. This is a maintained inventory, not a claim that every vendor command or future capability has been enumerated.
policy.globalAcceptance: For authoring features, verify real controls (or explicitly named public API), accurate geometry/units, a useful rejection, Undo/Redo where applicable and native persistence. Source and geometry authority remain shared. Format-fidelity contracts additionally require declared format versions and independent-tool fidelity checks. Navigation/read-only rows need their stated visible result without a fictitious persistence requirement.
policy.evidencePolicy: Done is bounded by the written row scope. Keep its executable journey and dated result. Historical evidence is identified; a known regression immediately resets done to false. No partial, planned or in-progress completion state and no percentage score.
policy.selectionPolicy: Fix regressions in Done rows first. Within the ordered frontier, choose a dependency-ready row that unlocks a complete user deliverable; extend its nearest E2E journey. Do not split easy rows or delete hard rows to inflate completion counts.

fusion.title: Autodesk Fusion modeling, manufacturing, electronics and simulation

interchange.scope: Real browser STEP cancel/retry, independent occurrence, selected cylindrical face offset, exact volumes, Undo/Redo and native reopen/edit.

assembly.scope: Actual distance/concentric controls, placement checks, Undo/Redo, Cancel and blocked invalid input.

mcp.scope: Real public stdio mounting-plate author/revise/exact-volume, dry-run, atomic rejection, native reopen and STEP readback.

engine.command: pnpm smoke:engine-interchange && pnpm --filter @web-cad/web build && PARTBENCH_SMOKE_UI_PRODUCTION=1 pnpm smoke:engine-interchange:browser
engine.scope: Pinned engine exact import/edit/history/native/STEP workflow; production render, orbit/select, native byte parity and cancellation of two workers. No latency target pass.

gearbox.scope: Recorded parametric spur gears, dependent ratio/spacing change, public discovery and motion with zero rebuilt exact definitions. Retained historical E2E evidence, not rerun for matrix authoring.

robot.scope: Recorded connected revolute-joint arm authoring/revision, source-linked frames, browser controls, persistence and motion. Retained historical E2E evidence, not rerun for matrix authoring.
